definitions: A system used on ships and by vessel traffic services (VTS) for identifying and locating vessels by electronically exchanging data with other nearby ships and VTS stations.
A condition in which the body's cells are unable to respond to androgens (male hormones), leading to a range of effects on sexual development.
examples: The ship's AIS transponder was active.
AIS is crucial for collision avoidance.
Individuals with AIS may have female external genitalia.
